description: Implied fractional iron absorption separating affected from unaffected heavy drinkers, and the mechanistic causal chain of African iron overload
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportion_confint

FE_BEER, LOSS = 46.0, 1.0
HEP_THRESH = 10.05e3   # mg Fe in liver at 400 umol/g dry wt
SHARE = 0.35

def abs_required(vol, years):
    """fractional absorption needed to cross hepatic threshold in `years`"""
    net = HEP_THRESH / (years*365.25*SHARE)
    return (net + LOSS)/(FE_BEER*vol)

# Observed: 23/111 exposed rural men >45y had iron overload (PMID 2872439)
k, n = 23, 111
p = k/n; lo, hi = proportion_confint(k, n, method='wilson')
print(f"Prevalence in exposed men >45y: {p:.3f} (95% CI {lo:.3f}-{hi:.3f})")
print("If the ingested dose alone were sufficient for everyone, prevalence -> ~1.0.")
print(f"Observed deficit: {(1-p)*100:.0f}% of equally exposed men do NOT load iron.\n")

# Bracket the absorption efficiency of affected vs unaffected at 2 L/day
V = 2.0
a_affected   = abs_required(V, 25)   # crosses threshold by ~25 y of drinking
a_unaffected = abs_required(V, 45)   # still below threshold after 45 y
print(f"At {V} L/day ({FE_BEER*V:.0f} mg Fe/day ingested):")
print(f"  absorption needed to cross threshold in 25 y : {a_affected*100:.2f}%")
print(f"  absorption that still fails after 45 y       : {a_unaffected*100:.2f}%")
print(f"  ratio = {a_affected/a_unaffected:.2f}-fold difference in fractional absorption\n")

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16.5, 9.2))
gs  = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1, 1.15], hspace=.33, wspace=.22)

# ---- panel A: required absorption vs volume, affected/unaffected bands ----
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
vols = np.linspace(0.5, 8, 200)
ax.fill_between(vols, [abs_required(v,25)*100 for v in vols],
                      [abs_required(v,45)*100 for v in vols],
                color="#f5b7b1", alpha=.75,
                label="band separating affected\nfrom unaffected drinkers")
ax.plot(vols, [abs_required(v,25)*100 for v in vols], color="#c0392b", lw=2.2,
        label="crosses threshold by 25 y")
ax.plot(vols, [abs_required(v,45)*100 for v in vols], color="#2471a3", lw=2.2,
        label="still below threshold at 45 y")
ax.set_xlabel("Traditional beer (L/day)"); ax.set_ylabel("Fractional Fe absorption (%)")
ax.set_ylim(0, 20)
ax.set_title("A. The affected/unaffected boundary is a ~1.8-fold\ndifference in fractional iron absorption", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3)

# ---- panel B: prevalence vs expectation under unregulated absorption ----
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
bars = ["Expected if dose\nalone sufficient", "Observed in exposed\nrural men >45 y"]
vals = [1.0, p]
errs = np.array([[0,p-lo],[0,hi-p]])
ax.bar(bars, vals, color=["#aab7b8", "#c0392b"], width=.55)
ax.errorbar([1], [p], yerr=errs[:,1:2], fmt='none', ecolor='k', capsize=5)
for i,v in enumerate(vals):
    ax.text(i, v+.03, f"{v*100:.0f}%", ha='center', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylim(0,1.18); ax.set_ylabel("Proportion with iron overload")
ax.set_title("B. Dose is sufficient but most exposed men are spared:\nabsorptive regulation is the gate", fontsize=10)
ax.grid(alpha=.3, axis='y')

# ---- panel C: causal chain ----
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:]); ax.axis("off")
steps = [
 ("1", "Traditional beer fermented in iron drums\n46 mg Fe/L, non-heme, highly soluble at pH 3.5", "#884ea0"),
 ("2", "Ingestion of 1-8 L/day for decades\n= 46-370 mg Fe/day presented to duodenum", "#884ea0"),
 ("3", "Failure to downregulate DMT1/ferroportin\nabsorption (partial hepcidin resistance)", "#c0392b"),
 ("4", "Net Fe retention 3-17 mg/day\nexceeds 1 mg/day obligate loss", "#c0392b"),
 ("5", "Loading of BOTH macrophages and hepatocytes\n(distinguishes from HFE disease)", "#d68910"),
 ("6", "Transferrin saturated >60%;\nnon-transferrin-bound iron appears", "#d68910"),
 ("7", "Fenton chemistry -> ROS, lipid peroxidation\n(MDA, 4-HNE), lysosomal fragility", "#196f3d"),
]
branches = [
 ("8a", "Stellate cell activation ->\nportal fibrosis -> cirrhosis", "#196f3d"),
 ("8b", "DNA strand breaks, TP53 mutation ->\nhepatocellular carcinoma (OR 10.6)", "#196f3d"),
 ("8c", "Macrophage Fe feeds M. tuberculosis ->\nTB death (OR 16.9)", "#196f3d"),
]
y = 0.93
for num, txt, c in steps:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((0.30, y-0.055), 0.40, 0.078,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.006", fc=c, ec="none", alpha=.17, transform=ax.transAxes))
    ax.text(0.325, y-0.016, num, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", color=c, transform=ax.transAxes)
    ax.text(0.355, y-0.016, txt, fontsize=8.6, va="center", transform=ax.transAxes)
    if num != "7":
        ax.annotate("", xy=(0.50, y-0.064), xytext=(0.50, y-0.052),
                    xycoords=ax.transAxes, textcoords=ax.transAxes,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color="0.35", lw=1.4))
    y -= 0.105
for i,(num, txt, c) in enumerate(branches):
    x = 0.045 + i*0.325
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((x, y-0.055), 0.29, 0.078,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.006", fc=c, ec="none", alpha=.17, transform=ax.transAxes))
    ax.text(x+0.018, y-0.016, num, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", color=c, transform=ax.transAxes)
    ax.text(x+0.055, y-0.016, txt, fontsize=8.4, va="center", transform=ax.transAxes)
    ax.annotate("", xy=(x+0.145, y-0.052), xytext=(0.50, y+0.046),
                xycoords=ax.transAxes, textcoords=ax.transAxes,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color="0.35", lw=1.3,
                                connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.12"))
ax.text(0.5, 1.0, "C. Causal chain of African iron overload: step 3 is the modifier-gated step",
        ha="center", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", transform=ax.transAxes)
plt.show()
